questions.question: What important annual day does chapter 16 establish?
What was done with the live "scapegoat"?
options: It was given to the priests to eat before the LORD
It was set free to roam freely within the camp
It was sent into the wilderness bearing the people's sins
It was slaughtered and its blood sprinkled all over the altar
questions.answer: It was sent into the wilderness bearing the people's sins
